reason.$comment: Canonical source of truth is greenlight's ALLOWED_REASONS. Keep this enum byte-identical to it, to the greenlight-review skill's reason list, and to validate-on-stop.sh's jq fallback so all four stay in sync.

allOf.$comment: A LAND may carry only `clean`. Every other reason names a reason not to land, and the land-time guard on pytorch/pytorch gates on the recorded status alone, so a LAND stamped with one of them would authorize exactly the merge its reason objects to. Mirrored by greenlight's constants.LAND_REASON and by validate-on-stop.sh's jq fallback.
